sets.name: Licence agreement
sets.engagement: IP licensing due diligence for evaluating the joint content license between WPT and Zynga as part of assessing Allied Esports Entertainment’s assets.

items.name: Joint Content License Agreement
items.what_it_is: The main contract governing the licensing of Zynga Poker content between WPT and Zynga.
items.why_needed: To understand rights, obligations, and scope of the licensed IP.

items.name: Amendments or Waivers to the Agreement
items.what_it_is: any subsequent modifications, extensions, or waivers agreed by parties.
items.why_needed: to assess current enforceability and any changed terms.

items.name: Trademark Registrations for ZYNGA POKER
items.what_it_is: USPTO/IPO registrations covering the licensed mark.
items.why_needed: to validate licensor's ownership of the IP being licensed.

sets.name: Franchise agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of the Airsopure franchise agreement to assess the viability of acquiring or operating a franchise unit.

items.name: Audited Financial Statements
items.what_it_is: Balance sheet, income statement, cash‑flow statement audited by an independent CPA.
items.why_needed: To evaluate the franchisor’s financial health and ability to support franchisees.

items.name: Trademark Registration Certificates
items.what_it_is: Certificates of registration for the AIRSOPURE trademarks and service marks.
items.why_needed: To confirm enforceability of licensed marks used by franchisees.

items.name: Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD)
items.what_it_is: The pre‑sale disclosure document required by the FTC Franchise Rule containing 23 items about the franchisor.
items.why_needed: To assess franchisor’s obligations, fees, litigation, and financial performance representations.

items.name: List of current franchisees
items.what_it_is: Disclosure of existing franchise owners with contact information and outlet locations.
items.why_needed: Enable validation of performance, turnover, and satisfaction.

items.name: Litigation Summary
items.what_it_is: Summary of pending and threatened lawsuits involving the franchisor.
items.why_needed: To evaluate legal risks and potential liabilities.

items.name: Insurance Certificates
items.what_it_is: Certificates of general liability, workers’ compensation and property insurance.
items.why_needed: To ensure adequate coverage for franchise operations.

items.name: Operations Manual
items.what_it_is: Confidential guide detailing standards, procedures, and training for franchise operation.
items.why_needed: Determine operational requirements and compliance burden.

sets.name: Endorsement agreement
sets.engagement: Review of the Tom Watson endorsement agreement with Adams Golf Ltd. for contractual completeness and risk assessment.

items.name: Audited Financial Statements
items.what_it_is: Adams Golf Ltd.’s most recent audited balance sheet, income statement, and cash‑flow statement.
items.why_needed: To assess the company’s ability to meet compensation and indemnity obligations under the agreement.

sets.name: Services agreement
sets.engagement: Contractual due‑diligence review of a Services Agreement between Provider and Recipients.

items.name: Exhibit A – Scope of Services
items.what_it_is: Attachment detailing the specific services, deliverables, and timelines.
items.why_needed: To verify what services are being provided and performance expectations.

items.name: Corporate Approvals (Board Resolutions)
items.what_it_is: Formal resolutions or authorizations from each party’s board approving the Agreement.
items.why_needed: To confirm the Agreement was validly executed and enforceable.

items.name: Confidentiality Agreement / Provisions
items.what_it_is: Separate NDA or confidentiality clauses governing protection of proprietary information.
items.why_needed: To ensure confidential information is adequately safeguarded and obligations are clear.

sets.name: SEC enforcement order
sets.engagement: SEC administrative proceeding alleging revenue recognition violations by Latch, Inc., settled via an Offer of Settlement and cease‑and‑desist order.

items.name: Offer of Settlement
items.what_it_is: The respondent's proposed settlement agreement submitted to the SEC.
items.why_needed: To verify the terms admitted and any conditions tied to the cease‑and‑desist order.

items.name: Restated financial statements
items.what_it_is: Revised financial statements reflecting corrected revenue recognition.
items.why_needed: To confirm the adjustments described in the SEC order.

items.name: Internal investigation report
items.what_it_is: Report detailing Latch's internal review of side agreements and collectability assessments.
items.why_needed: To understand root cause and scope of violations.
items.note: A section with a similar heading exists in sec-order-latch.txt: "Respondent’s Internal Investigation and Restatement". Check whether it is what is needed.

sets.name: Annual report (10-K)
sets.engagement: Financial due‑diligence review of United Parcel Service, Inc. using its FY 2020 Form 10‑K.

items.name: DEF 14A Proxy Statement
items.what_it_is: Annual proxy statement covering director elections, executive compensation and related‑party transactions.
items.why_needed: Needed to assess governance and compensation details referenced in Items 10‑13 of the 10‑K.

items.name: Form 10‑Q for Q1‑Q3 2020
items.what_it_is: Quarterly reports providing interim financial statements and MD&A for the first three quarters of 2020.
items.why_needed: Required to evaluate trends and supplement the annual MD&A (Item 7) and selected financial data (Item 6).
items.note: A section with a similar heading exists in UPS_10-K_2020.txt: "Item 9B. Other Information". Check whether it is what is needed.

items.name: Material contracts exhibited as exhibits (e.g., credit agreement, union contracts)
items.what_it_is: Actual agreements listed in the Exhibit Index (Item 15) such as debt facilities and collective bargaining agreements.
items.why_needed: Needed to confirm terms of debt, financing arrangements and labor obligations referenced in Notes 9 and 6.

sets.name: Earnings release
sets.engagement: Preparing or reviewing an SEC Form 8‑K (Item 2.02) that incorporates the Franklin Covey earnings release as Exhibit 99.1.

items.name: Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A)
items.what_it_is: Narrative explanation of financial results, liquidity, and known trends from management.
items.why_needed: Provides context for performance and forward-looking risks evident in the release.

sets.name: Small data room: contract, order and release
sets.engagement: Due diligence assessment of a potential business relationship involving multiple counterparties, focusing on contractual obligations, regulatory compliance, and financial performance.

items.name: Offer of Settlement
items.what_it_is: The settlement offer Latch provided to the SEC, including any undertakings or monetary penalties.
items.why_needed: To determine the exact terms and financial impact of the enforcement action.
